messages.subject: For Christian Milau | Responsible growth, government relations and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Gould,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Christian Milau, President and Chief Executive Officer.

Eldorado Gold is entering a major growth phase across Greece, Türkiye and Canada, with project execution increasingly dependent on strong government relationships, local partnerships, community confidence and disciplined sustainability governance.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work combines government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships, local participation and executive advisory across a major mining operation. I also support stakeholder governance around renewable-energy infrastructure and carbon-accounting evidence work.

I would value a conversation about where this operating-side experience might support Eldorado's responsible-growth, stakeholder, government-relations or country-facing leadership priorities. My attached CV is tailored specifically to that contribution.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
